pre_review_exact_head_ci.workflow: ANIMO SQ09 TCD016 C1 Explicit Model Evolution

reconstruction.legacy_problem: TCD-016 establishes a wet-to-dry surface NH4 mass representation defect. Upstream Class C work defines a persistent continuation owner, but no qualified rewetting transfer-out process exists.
reconstruction.frozen_state_contract: M_surface_NH4_non_aqueous_continuation is persistent NH4-N mass in kg N m-2 owned by the surface chemistry ponding control volume; specific material phase and molecular speciation are unresolved.
reconstruction.candidate_semantics: When explicit positive surface aqueous storage exists, atomically transfer all continuation mass to SURFACE_AQUEOUS_NH4_STORAGE; otherwise persist fail-closed. No threshold, fraction, rate coefficient or calibration parameter is introduced.

H1_parameter_free_minimality_is_enough_f.reason: Parsimony and absence of calibration parameters reduce arbitrariness but do not establish that complete instantaneous remobilization is physically correct.

H2_mass_conservation_is_sufficient_proce.reason: Exact conservation constrains accounting and typed-transfer algebra only. Multiple mutually incompatible physical release laws can conserve the same NH4-N mass.

H3_generic_ammonium_chemistry_can_supply.reason: SQ08 leaves the continuation material physically unidentified. Generic ammonium solubility or remobilization knowledge does not establish a source-to-state material mapping or the selected complete-transfer kinetics.

H4_existing_revision53_processes_can_be_.reason: The pinned SQ04 audit found no audited revision-53 NH4 route semantically reusable unchanged for the continuation state. Adaptation would itself require separate qualification.

H5_indefinite_fail_closed_persistence_ca.reason: Persistence is valid safety/state semantics while no process is qualified, but promoting it to permanent model physics would leave the continuation-out lifecycle undefined.

H6_direct_transfer_to_soil_is_equally_su.reason: Current evidence cannot discriminate a direct-to-soil receiver from surface aqueous, partial or delayed alternatives. This undercuts scientific admission of M1 rather than qualifying H6.

H7_synthetic_oracles_validate_physical_t.reason: The SQ09 oracle proves candidate algebra, no double transfer and conservation only; the fragment explicitly disclaims physical and historical validation.

H8_missing_B2_requires_abandoning_the_ne.reason: Historical revision-53 behavior remains UNKNOWN_WITHOUT_B2. That uncertainty prevents historical-fidelity claims but does not convert missing authoritative theory and process validation into PASS evidence.

active_and_negative_controls.active_transfer_control: SQ09-ME-02 requires exact complete candidate transfer when the candidate activation flag is true.
active_and_negative_controls.dry_negative_control: SQ09-ME-01 requires zero transfer and exact continuation persistence while surface aqueous storage is inactive.
active_and_negative_controls.zero_source_negative_control: SQ09-ME-03 requires active surface water with zero continuation mass to remain a no-op.
active_and_negative_controls.repeat_activation_negative_control: SQ09-ME-04 requires no double transfer after source exhaustion.
active_and_negative_controls.delayed_activation_control: SQ09-ME-05 requires dry persistence before a later candidate activation.
active_and_negative_controls.interpretation: These controls validate the proposed state-machine contract only and do not discriminate physical alternatives.

state_restart_and_failure_review.state_identity: PASS: inherited continuation state identity, unit and owner remain unchanged.
state_restart_and_failure_review.restart_before_activation: PASS_AT_CONTRACT_LEVEL: exact M_cont persistence is inherited; no hidden phase memory is introduced.
state_restart_and_failure_review.atomic_event_semantics: PASS_AT_CONTRACT_LEVEL: candidate transfer is all-or-nothing and no half-applied checkpoint state is part of the contract.
state_restart_and_failure_review.failure_semantics: PASS_FAIL_CLOSED: without explicit positive surface aqueous storage no candidate transfer occurs.
state_restart_and_failure_review.production_restart_claim: NONE: SQ09 contains no production implementation and therefore does not claim executable production split-run qualification.
